body.html: Amenity and condiment boxes, guest directories, pen pots and further service accessories, specified around the way you work.

media.alt: Open amenity box with grooming accessories on a dressing table

body.html: A special box, an unusual format or a coordinated ensemble: some ideas call for fully bespoke development. We agree the construction and appropriate materials with you, followed by hand manufacture in the EU. One-offs and very small runs are welcome, alongside major projects involving many coordinated objects.
Smaller operational details deserve the same attention. Alongside the main collections, we develop solutions for guest amenities, documents and service routines.

media.alt: Open amenity box holding guest toiletries — product photograph with an edited setting

body.html: Choose from genuine Italian leather, high-quality PU and other materials available for the product. We use samples to agree colour, finish and construction for your accessory.
Blind debossing presses the design into the surface without colour. Foil stamping adds a coloured or metallic finish. We agree the method, size and position to suit the material.
Find individual models, material choices and specification options in our complete accessory collection.
